scope: Repeated STL/OBJ/PLY/OFF model restore pressure/cancellation, complete serialized payload preservation and Metal frame comparison in one disk cache
checks: Full root reservation refuses restore without corrupting disk cache or incrementing swap errors
Canceled lookup returns no frame and allocates no restored geometry
Every restored serialized geometry/metadata payload exactly matches original
Every Metal output pixel equals initial model frame
Managed restored geometry credit equals capacity while owned and returns to zero after drop
One cache/directory retained for all six models and repeated restores
Exactly six writes and 120 reads in repeated scenario, zero errors/dropped writes, final queue zero
limits_of_evidence: Six small fixtures, not large production meshes or all 3D producer/material/texture variants
64x64 SDR offscreen frame preservation, not physical HDR model rendering
Managed restore/queue budgets do not account for every driver allocation or temporary test triangle vector
Immediate cancellation check, not every mid-stream cancellation race
Finite 120 restores are not a multi-hour 3D collection soak
